title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young female warrior with white hair in buns and braids stands in a dynamic fighting pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with armored elements, holding a glowing purple energy ring in her right hand while casting a swirling purple magical orb from her raised left hand, surrounded by crackling purple energy effects around her head.
